note: Required metadata for every function that is NOT in function-baseline.json (i.e. every NEW function). Legacy functions are classified by the analyzer; add an entry here when you want to override their risk tier. 'auth' must be backed by the code (see docs/security/function-matrix.md). Public functions need a justification.

dsar-request.justification: Public /data-request form used by people who may have no account. Identity is proven by a one-time email code (HMAC-hashed, 15 min TTL, 5 attempts); atomic IP/email rate limits; honeypot; 16 KB body cap. Requiring a session would block the legal right of access.

careers-sitemap.justification: Public SEO sitemap; reads only OPEN postings through RLS with the anon key. No input. Rate limited (fail-open) and query length bounded.

status-feed.justification: Public status page feed; public_status_feed() exposes no phones, tenants or regions. ?format validated. Rate limited (fail-open).

job-feeds.justification: Public XML feeds crawled by Indeed/ZipRecruiter/LinkedIn; 404 until staff enable a board; board name allow-listed. Rate limited (fail-open).

google-booking-feed.justification: Public availability feed for Google; publishes only verified availability, slug validated, 404 otherwise. Rate limited per client+slug (fail-open). POST preview requires the owner JWT.

event-register.justification: Public event registration form; honeypot, validation, atomic per-event flood guard and capacity in register_for_public_event().

warranty-register.justification: Public warranty registration; honeypot, validation, atomic per-IP limit (wr_rate_limit_hit, fail-closed) in the function.

membership-join-checkout.justification: Public membership signup; honeypot, strict validation, per-plan and per-email hourly caps, Stripe Connect checkout; membership only becomes active via the signed Stripe webhook.

exit-dataroom-public.justification: Buyer data-room link; 256-bit token (hash only), attempts logged, expiry/revocation/view cap and rate limit enforced atomically in exit_dataroom_open().

punchout-return.justification: Supplier cart return posted by the user's browser; credential is the one-time 256-bit BuyerCookie (hash only, single use, 4 h). Per-client rate limit (fail-closed). Creates a staging copy only, never an order.

video-ice.justification: Guest video sessions have no account; credential is the 64-hex session token validated by get_video_session_public(). Per-client and per-token rate limit (fail-closed) because TURN credentials cost money.
